assertion: Undamped, critically damped and overdamped springs start after 0.25s; overshoot and settling survive reverse and alternating seeks.

valle.reason: Seven Metal frames visually reviewed. Horizontal positions agree within raster coverage rounding with 1-cos(2πt), 1-(1+4t)exp(-4t), and 1-4/3 exp(-2t)+1/3 exp(-8t), starting at 0.25s. The undamped row crosses its target and returns; the other rows settle.
